description:
This endpoint creates a new Feature Flag or Setting in a specified Config
identified by the `configId` parameter.

**Important:** The `key` attribute must be unique within the given Config.

hint.description: A short description for the setting, shown on the Dashboard UI.

environmentId.description: The ID of the Environment where the initial value must be set.

value.description: The initial value in the given Environment. It must respect the setting type. In some generated clients for strictly typed languages, you may use double/float properties to handle integer values. In case of a Feature Flag with predefined variations, the value must match one of the predefined variations' value.

initialValues.description: Optional, initial value of the Feature Flag or Setting in the given Environments. Only one of the SettingIdToInitFrom or the InitialValues properties can be set.

isJson.description: Indicates whether this setting should validate string values as JSON values.

key.description: The key of the Feature Flag or Setting.

name.description: The name of the Feature Flag or Setting.

order.description:
The order of the Setting represented on the ConfigCat Dashboard.
Determined from an ascending sequence of integers.

hint.description: The name of the Predefined Variation, shown on the Dashboard UI. If not set, the Value will be shown.

name.description: The name of the Predefined Variation, shown on the Dashboard UI. If not set, the Value will be shown.

value.description: Represents the value of a Predefined Variation.

boolValue.description: The served value in case of a boolean Feature Flag.

doubleValue.description: The served value in case of a decimal number Setting.

intValue.description: The served value in case of a whole number Setting.

stringValue.description: The served value in case of a text Setting.

predefinedVariations.description: The Feature Flag or Setting's Variations.

settingIdToInitFrom.description: Optional, the SettingId to initialize the values and tags of the Feature Flag or Setting from. Only can be set if you have at least ReadOnly access in all the Environments. Only one of the SettingIdToInitFrom or the InitialValues properties can be set.

settingType.description: The type of the Feature Flag or Setting.

tags.description: The IDs of the tags which are attached to the setting.

name: create-setting
